action: Create one normal reviewed audit-remediation commit and push it to the existing upstream

approval.source: current user request and its single clarification round
approval.clarification: User delegated autonomous decisions; choose audit fixes/evidence only, existing upstream, unchanged version/date metadata.

ruleTrace: Current explicit commit/push authority supersedes the earlier local-only remediation limit only for this bounded delivery.
The user delegated ordinary scope decisions after the required three-question round.
The real index is unchanged and the approved upstream was observed at the expected base revision.
Only the selected audit fixes and their necessary evidence/history context may enter the commit.
conditions: The exact isolated candidate must pass focused and full checks plus a fresh offline secret scan.
Verify no worktree/index drift before staging; preserve unrelated pending changes.
Reject a changed upstream or non-fast-forward push; no force push, branch replacement, history rewrite, dependency installation, cloud operation, tag or release publication.
Do not reuse historical scan receipts as current proof after candidate, index, ref or HEAD changes.
